subtitle: Why Customers Choose You
sentences: Today, I would like to talk about the value proposition, a key idea in MBA marketing and strategy.
A value proposition is a clear promise of the benefits that customers will receive from a product.
It answers one simple question: why should a customer choose you instead of a competitor?
A strong value proposition focuses on solving a real customer problem, not just listing product features.
When the promise is clear, it guides marketing, product design, and even pricing decisions.
For example, Airbnb offers travelers a unique local experience, often at a lower price than a hotel.
